subject.title: fix(telegram): scope dispatch dedupe by bot identity

question: Should upgrades intentionally ignore unexpired identity-ambiguous V1 Telegram dispatch claims, accepting at most one V1-to-V2 redelivery to prevent cross-bot false suppression?
rationale: Tests and proof establish the technical behavior, but choosing between a bounded duplicate and continued use of an identity-ambiguous persisted claim is a Telegram delivery-policy decision.

options.title: Approve the V2-only cutover
options.body: Accept one possible redelivery at the upgrade boundary so reused state cannot suppress a different bot’s inbound message.

options.title: Specify a transition policy
options.body: Pause merge until the Telegram owner defines a different upgrade contract for still-live V1 claims.

options.title: Defer the change
options.body: Do not land this PR if neither bounded duplicate delivery nor retiring ambiguous state is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve the V2-only cutover
recommendation.body: Accept one possible redelivery at the upgrade boundary so reused state cannot suppress a different bot’s inbound message.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest refactor and documentation commits directly implement and explain the decision surface.
